Ryan,
Just to unpack Yves' reply a little if the error message surprises you:  The period is a valid name for an R object.

. <- "I am an R object!"
> .
[1] "I am an R object!"

One generally avoids using '.' as a name of an R object in the interest of readability.  However, much like allowing the user to assign TRUE to F and FALSE to T, R will not stop you if you decide to go that route.  So, R interpreted your extra decimal point as an undefined object in your workspace.

Keith
